# RANDOM.ORG Accounts

> Central authentication and account management hub for RANDOM.ORG's premium random number generation and drawing services.

RANDOM.ORG Accounts provides user registration, login, account recovery, and configuration guides for accessing premium services powered by atmospheric noise-based randomness. The platform supports integration with email providers like Outlook and manages access to third-party draw services and business account features.

## Key Topics

- Account Creation
- Authentication
- Login & Sign-Up
- Account Recovery
- Password Reset
- User Registration
- Premium Services
- Outlook Email Setup
- Account Management
- RANDOM.ORG
- Third-Party Draw Service
- Atmospheric Noise
- User Signup
- Account Access

## Authentication & Account Access

- [Login or Sign Up](https://accounts.random.org): RANDOM.ORG login and account creation hub for premium services
- [Create an Account](https://accounts.random.org/create): Account registration form for RANDOM.ORG with premium service setup
- [Recover Your Account](https://accounts.random.org/recover): Password reset and account recovery assistance for RANDOM.ORG users

## Configuration & Setup Guides

- [How to Guides](https://accounts.random.org/guides): Account configuration guides including Outlook email setup instructions
- [How to Add a Safe Domain in Outlook](https://accounts.random.org/guides/allow-emails-outlook): Step-by-step guide for configuring safe domains in Outlook email

## Optional

- [Test Account 9](https://accounts.random.org/profiles/8464): Test user profile page for RANDOM.ORG account demonstration
- [Test Account 11](https://accounts.random.org/profiles/8860): Test business account profile for RANDOM.ORG API and draw services
